parsed.explanation: Lemma (ii) is the sole vehicle for the all-n lower bound (Section 3 invokes it directly), so its inductive step must be written out. As given, the dichotomy's induction rests on one unproved clause, and the arithmetic in it is wrong: columns d,2d,...,2^j d total (2^{j+1}-1)d strips, while the next column has 2^{j+1} strips, i.e. one copy of the preceding strips plus one extra, not 'two identical copies'. Nor is 'a cut can interchange the two parity rows only above its level' justified, nor the passage from the second alternative to s+1 cuts. Only a pointer to lemmas/refinement.md exists; nothing else in the text proves (ii). Repair requires supplying the lemma's proof.
